correctness.rationale: Consequent monotonicity and the identity a→b=a→(a∧b) make each row constant above its antecedent. The lower-bound axiom plus importation makes every row value a fixed point, giving the least-fixed-point ceiling formula. Importation between antecedents b<a is equivalent to nesting S_b⊆S_a plus the stated summit condition. Conditional identity and semicomplementation reduce T/F chain expansions to nested fixed-point sets, and the derived negation makes DNE automatic. The direct checker exhausts raw operations through n=3 and independently verifies normal-form operations through n=8.

value.rationale: Finite chains are canonical finite algebras in ordered logic. The new K/T/F hierarchy is algebraically abstract; the accepted theorem gives a complete concrete chain model, proves an unexpected collapse T=F on every finite chain, and gives the exact factorial number of stronger expansions. This supplies a natural baseline for finite algebra generation and distinguishes the new preconditional semantics from the unique Heyting implication.
